zh: 总代价只取决于每个字母最终出现了几次（出现 f 次贡献 f(f−1)/2），与位置无关；所以先决定每个字母补几个，再决定放在哪里。
给某个字母再补一个的边际代价等于它当前的出现次数，所以每个问号都应补给当前次数最少的字母，次数相同时选字母更小的。
统计已知字母的次数，对每个问号从 26 个字母中取（次数, 字母）最小者并把它的次数加一；最后把补上的字母按字母序升序，依次填进从左到右的问号。
en: The total cost depends only on how many times each letter appears in the end (f occurrences cost f(f−1)/2), not on positions; so first decide how many of each letter to add, then where to put them.
Adding one more copy of a letter costs its current count, so each ? should go to the letter with the smallest current count, the smaller letter on ties.

Count the known letters; for each ?, pick the minimum (count, letter) among the 26 letters and increment its count. Then write the added letters in ascending alphabetical order into the ? positions from left to right.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First count all known characters. Use a 26-entry min-heap to repeatedly choose the letter with the smallest current frequency, breaking ties by the smaller letter; record only how many copies of each letter are added, and finally fill the ? positions with the added letters in ascending order.

## Proof of correctness

A letter with frequency f has total cost C(f,2); the next copy costs f, and each later one costs one more. Merging the 26 increasing marginal-cost sequences and taking the q smallest values achieves the minimum total cost; breaking marginal ties with the smaller letter makes the added multiset lexicographically smallest. The cost does not depend on positions, so this multiset is placed in ascending order into the ? positions from left to right: swapping any inversion makes the result smaller without changing the cost, so the secondary objective is optimal too.

## Complexity

O(n log 26) time; O(n) space including the result, and O(26) for the frequencies and the heap.
